title: Distributed Tracing with OpenTelemetry & .NET Aspire
description: Trace multi-step AI pipelines end-to-end using OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions, W3C trace propagation, and the .NET Aspire dashboard.

data.text: The Challenge of Multi-Hop AI Diagnostics

In a modern AI system, a single user query can trigger a complex distributed waterfall: an HTTP request from a React client hits an API gateway, which invokes an agent in ASP.NET Core, which dispatches three parallel hybrid search queries to a vector database, executes an external tool call against a microservice, and finally waits on an Azure OpenAI completion. When a response takes 7 seconds, which component caused the delay? Distributed tracing answers this by linking every step into a single causal tree of Spans sharing a unique Trace ID.

data.text: Instrumenting Custom Spans in C# with ActivitySource

In .NET, OpenTelemetry traces are instrumented using System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource. This is zero-overhead when tracing is disabled, but captures rich contextual spans when an OpenTelemetry exporter is active.

data.text: Debugging AI Workflows in .NET Aspire Dashboard

.NET Aspire provides a world-class local telemetry dashboard. When developing AI applications with Aspire, every trace is visualized in real-time as an interactive waterfall. You can click on any individual tool-call span to inspect exact JSON arguments, review token usage per step, and pinpoint whether latency originated in network transmission, database indexing, or model inference.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Distributed tracing correlates disparate microservices and tool executions under a single Trace ID
Propagate W3C TraceContext headers (traceparent) across HTTP and messaging boundaries
Follow OpenTelemetry GenAI semantic conventions (gen_ai.system, gen_ai.usage.input_tokens)
Use System.Diagnostics.ActivitySource in C# to emit zero-overhead telemetry spans
Leverage the .NET Aspire dashboard for local real-time debugging of AI latency waterfalls
data.takeaway: Distributed tracing eliminates guesswork in complex AI architectures. By following OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions and inspecting spans in .NET Aspire, engineers diagnose bottlenecks with surgical precision.
